warmup_rule: NEWEST only when no valid past query exists (decision 0)
source_rule: argmin over q<t, t-q<50 of abs((T_t-T_q)-1.0s); ties choose the more recent q

executed_source_age_contract.FULL_OLD_1S: all channels execute the q* candidate age
executed_source_age_contract.FO_1S: arms execute source age 0; grippers execute the q* candidate age
